output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Only 7.4.0 users can have the flag, so flag-on versus everyone else compares 7.4.0 with 7.3.2. Build 7.4.0 crashed at about 2% from 2 Sep, before the flag ramp, against about 0.7% for 7.3.2. Within 7.4.0, flag-on is 2.10% and the random flag-off holdout is 1.98%. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. The leading crash cluster, 41% of events, is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda), and no top cluster involves canvas code. Device mix, usage intensity, the crash-reporting SDK change and the sync-service deploy don't explain the gap. The app-store console, which is independent of the SDK, shows the same gap. A small flag effect of a few tenths of a point can't yet be ruled out. Don't ship the plan as written. Turning the flag off would not fix anything, and 7.4.0 going to 100% would put the crash rate at roughly 2% for everyone. Hold 7.4.0 at 25% and fix the Pixelda crashes. Keep the existing holdout running to settle the flag question. Widening it would save about a week, so it's optional. Don't roll back the SDK.
